_comment: Station log. 'station' entries are quoted from the e-Callisto network journal at https://www.e-callisto.org/Journal.html and describe the instrument itself. 'site' entries are changes to this monitoring software. Add new entries at the top.

posts.title: New log-periodic antenna and rotator gearing
posts.body: A new LPDA went up, together with a 3D-printed shroud protecting the feedpoint connector from weather. The rotator's encoder and gear assembly were rebuilt at the same time.
posts.quote: Croatia new LPDA incl. 3D-printed connector-protection. New encoder/gear construction

posts.title: Back on-line, and quiet
posts.body: The station returned to service after a break, and — the part that matters for a radio site — with low interference. Clean spectra depend far more on the local RFI environment than on the receiver itself.
posts.quote: Croatia Visnjan back on-line with nice results and low rfi

posts.title: First light
posts.body: At 07:41 UT the station recorded its first real solar observation. This is the date the archive counts from, and every spectrogram on this site is measured against it.

posts.title: Continuous upload begins
posts.body: The station moved from occasional test files to uploading continuously, which is what makes a station useful to the network: the value of e-Callisto is that some station somewhere is always watching.
posts.quote: Croatia-Visnjan starting with continous files upload

posts.title: First files reach the archive
posts.body: The first data from Croatia-Visnjan arrived at the central archive — the point at which the station existed as far as the rest of the network was concerned.
